newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-RIOS' WINNING RUN ENDS IN CZECH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-RIOS' WINNING RUN ENDS IN CZECH OPEN.

text.p: Chilean Marcelo Rios's recent run of fine form came to a halt when he crashed out of the quarter-finals of the $365,000 Czech Open tennis tournament on Friday.
Second seed Rios lost to unseeded Frenchman Fabrice Santoro 4-6 6-3 6-0.
Rios, coming off his biggest tournament win at the Monte Carlo Open last week, battled evenly with Santoro for the first two sets before being undone by a spate of unforced errors.
Third-seeded Czech Bohdan Ulihrach overcame a slow start against Spaniard Albert Portas, winning 2-6 6-4 6-4 to remain the highest remaining seed left in the tournament.
Fourth seed Cedric Pioline of France was also stretched to three sets before overcoming Australia's Richard Fromberg 6-4 4-6 6-2.
Santoro will meet Ulihrach in one semifinal on Saturday, while Pioline faces Spain's Emilio Alvarez, who beat German qualifier Marcello Craca 6-3 7-5.
